correctness.rationale: The lower bound covers all feasible labelings by splitting on whether a part is fully positive; the no-full-part case reduces to a two-defender parity lemma, and explicit constructions attain both modes. Exact support enumeration agrees for 359 complete multipartite types through order 13, while direct label enumeration agrees for 37 types through order 7.

originality.rationale: The introducing total-strong-Roman source gives general bounds and tree results but no complete-multipartite exact formula, and the compared neighboring results concern non-total, signed, unique-response, or ordinary total-domination variants. No equivalent or stronger complete-multipartite statement was found in the checked literature or prior accepted ledger.

value.rationale: The formula solves an infinite natural family from its part sizes, unifies complete graphs, stars, bicliques, and Turan-type graphs, and exposes a nontrivial parity saving in the two-defender regime.
